entities.summary: Elias Peter Hoayek (Arabic: الياس بطرس الحويّك; 4 December 1843 – 24 December 1931; was the 72nd Maronite Catholic Patriarch of Antioch from 1898 until his death in 1931.He was also one of the most influential Lebanese political leaders especially from 1918 to 1920
